title: Compact projection formula for actual derived Weil complexes
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$, and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a separated finite-type morphism between separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes. Use the actual derived Weil categories, actual chosen compactification functor $Rf_{0!}$, and module pullback $f^*$ of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], restricted by [lem-sf-native-weil-shriek-triangulated] and [lem-sf-native-weil-pullback-star-preservation], and the tensor of [def-sf-derived-weil-category-and-operations] over $B_X,B_Y$. For every $M\in\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(X_0)$ and $T\in\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(Y_0)$ there is a natural isomorphism in the actual derived Weil category
$$\pi_{M,T}:Rf_{0!}M\otimes^L_{B_Y}T\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{0!}(M\otimes^L_{B_X}f^*T).$$
It is the compactification projection isomorphism formed from extension by zero and proper derived module pushforward, with all morphisms taken in $D(\mathcal W_Y)$, restricted to its bounded constructible full subcategory. The formula applies to an arbitrary bounded constructible derived Weil complex $T$, not merely a lisse sheaf in degree zero.

proof.text: Fix the chosen compactification $X_0\xrightarrow{j_0}Z_0\xrightarrow{p_0}Y_0$ of the native framework, so $Rf_{0!}=Rp_{0*}j_{0!}$. Put $A=j_{0!}M$. The native basic comparisons give $A$ bounded constructible; explicitly exactness gives $H^r(A)=j_{0!}H^r(M)$, and extending each finite stratification by the closed complement with rank zero preserves constructibility. Since $p_0$ is proper and $Y_0$ finite type, finite-type composition gives $Z_0$ finite type. The diagonal $Z_0\to Z_0\times_{k_0}Z_0$ factors through $Z_0\times_{Y_0}Z_0$: the first factor is closed by properness and the second is the base change of the closed diagonal of $Y_0$. Closed immersions compose, since quotient ring maps compose to quotient by the inverse-image ideal. Thus $Z_0$ is separated, and geometric base change preserves this scheme domain.

source.place: Step 1, second Hom bijection: chosen-compactification factorization; scheme-domain check: Stacks 01T3 (finite-type composition), 01QR (closed base change), 01KU (diagonal factorization)

proof.text:
Apply the native proper comparison to $(A,T)$ and the native open tensor comparison to $(M,p_0^*T)$. Their natural isomorphisms compose as
$$Rp_{0*}j_{0!}M\otimes^LT\xrightarrow{\alpha^W}Rp_{0*}(j_{0!}M\otimes^Lp_0^*T)\xrightarrow{Rp_{0*}\gamma^W}Rp_{0*}j_{0!}(M\otimes^Lj_0^*p_0^*T).$$
Use the balanced equivariant pullback compositor supplied by the open comparison to identify $j_0^*p_0^*T$ with $f_0^*T$. By the definition of $Rf_{0!}$ this is precisely the chosen compactification projection isomorphism. Each arrow and its inverse lies in the actual ambient derived Weil category and is natural in both derived variables.

source.place: Step 1, second Hom bijection; proper/open projection composite

proof.text: Finally, $Rf_{0!}M$ and $Rf_{0!}(M\otimes^Lf_0^*T)$ belong to $\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(Y_0)$: pullback preservation gives $f_0^*T$, tensor closure gives $M\otimes^Lf_0^*T$, and compact-support preservation applies to both inputs. Tensor closure also gives $Rf_{0!}M\otimes^LT$ in that subcategory. Since it is full, the ambient isomorphism and its inverse are morphisms in this subcategory, with their same naturality equations. This proves the entire claimed formula for every bounded constructible derived $T$.
